recognize_zh: 低倍下骨小樑之間的骨髓腔被單一形態細胞完全填滿（約 100% cellularity），沒有脂肪也看不到正常三系造血；高倍為成片均一的小至中型圓核母細胞、細胞質稀少，符合骨髓被淋巴母細胞取代。
features: Hypercellular marrow (approximately 100%) with complete loss of fat spaces between bony trabeculae
Diffuse, monotonous sheets of small-to-intermediate cells effacing the marrow
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with fine chromatin and scant cytoplasm (high N:C ratio)
Near absence of recognizable megakaryocytes, erythroid islands and maturing granulocytes
describe_en: Core biopsy of bone marrow shows a markedly hypercellular marrow (approximately 100% cellularity) with obliteration of fat spaces. At high power, the marrow is diffusely replaced by monotonous sheets of small-to-intermediate blasts with round to slightly irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and scant cytoplasm. Normal trilineage hematopoiesis, including megakaryocytes, is essentially absent. Together with immunophenotyping, findings are consistent with extensive marrow involvement by B-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Packed marrow by AML blasts looks similar on H&E; separation requires IHC or flow (MPO, CD117 versus CD19/PAX5, TdT).

ddx.dx: Marrow involvement by small lymphocytic lymphoma
ddx.vs: SLL cells have condensed chromatin and often form paratrabecular or nodular aggregates with proliferation centers rather than blastic sheets.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor (e.g., neuroblastoma, Ewing sarcoma)
ddx.vs: These form cohesive nests or rosettes with desmoplasia and are negative for CD45/TdT and B-cell markers.
